protocol.difference_sign: method minus direct; negative favours method
protocol.bootstrap_unit: chronologically ordered scored sessions, circular moving blocks
protocol.uncertainty_scope: conditional descriptive bootstrap with nominal 95% percentile intervals; not a model confidence interval; no model-selection or multiple-comparison correction
protocol.coverage_scope: scored-record union; attempted and issued counts require the separate forecast audit
protocol.outcome_strata_scope: ex-post realized outcomes, not past-only regime forecasts
protocol.influence_scope: post-hoc deletions; full-sample primary results remain unchanged

loss_interpretation.target: conditional second moment E[P&L squared | past], not automatically conditional variance
loss_interpretation.qlike_expected_regret: log(v/m) + m/v - 1 for v,m>0; v is floored before QLIKE scoring
loss_interpretation.quadratic_expected_regret: (v-m)^2; original nonnegative v is used without flooring
loss_interpretation.proxy_requirement: paired methods share exactly the same outcome; conditional proxy mean must equal the target
loss_interpretation.rank_reversal: QLIKE weights relative underprediction more strongly; quadratic weights absolute squared-risk errors
loss_interpretation.distribution: no Gaussian likelihood or trading profitability interpretation
loss_interpretation.score_units: quadratic in CNY^4; QLIKE uses the fixed CNY^2 convention and paired differences are unit invariant
